title: Artificial intelligence models Traditional Chinese Medicine principles to integrate with biomedicine.
summary: A Transformer autoencoder trained on 26,339 eligible TCM formula records learned a low-dimensional symptom-pattern/formula space; held-out/untrained TCM principles align with the representation, ten-model robustness and post-hoc biomedical analyses support a bounded computational result. Testing: The paper reports reproducibility across ten independently trained models and alignment/baseline analyses; biomedical therapeutic prioritization is exploratory..
